item.title: Show HN: Pistachio – Declarative schema management for PostgreSQL
item.summary: Pistachio is a declarative schema migration tool similar to sqldef, with a Terraform-like plan/apply workflow. I created this tool because there were some SQL statements that sqldef couldn't parse. Pistachio uses pg_query_go. Demo: docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/winebarrel/pistachio-demo Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49181635 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
